meta.prompt: Show the change you want to make to my config.yaml as a diff I can review, in three separate hunks with line numbers, removed lines red and added lines green in a monospace font. Hunk 1 (Server port, lines 4 to 5): -port: 8080 +port: 9090. Hunk 2 (Logging, lines 12 to 15): -level: debug -file: /tmp/app.log +level: warn +file: /var/log/app.log. Hunk 3 (Cache, lines 20 to 22): +enabled: true +ttl: 300. Keep and Discard buttons on each hunk, a count of how many are decided and how many kept, and an Apply button that only works once all three are decided; after Apply the card says how many hunks were kept and how many discarded.
meta.text:
I'll build this with the DiffHunk component. Each hunk keeps its decision in its own text variable, a count tracks decisions, and Apply is enabled only when all three are decided.

state h1=""
state h2=""
state h3=""
state kept=0
state done=0
let decided = (h1!="" ? 1 : 0) + (h2!="" ? 1 : 0) + (h3!="" ? 1 : 0)
let keptCount = (h1=="keep" ? 1 : 0) + (h2=="keep" ? 1 : 0) + (h3=="keep" ? 1 : 0)
let discarded = 3 - keptCount
node {"type": "Column", "props": {"width": 390}}
  Card gap:10
    Text.heading "Review config.yaml"
    Text.muted "{decided} of 3 decided, {keptCount} kept"
    DiffHunk =h1 "Server port" "lines 4 to 5" start:4 lines:["-port: 8080","+port: 9090"]
    DiffHunk =h2 "Logging" "lines 12 to 15" start:12 lines:["-level: debug","-file: /tmp/app.log","+level: warn","+file: /var/log/app.log"]
    DiffHunk =h3 "Cache" "lines 20 to 22" start:20 lines:["+enabled: true","+ttl: 300"]
    ActionButton "Apply" primary enabled:{decided==3} -> done=1
    if done==1
      Receipt "Changes applied" "{keptCount} hunks kept, {discarded} discarded" tone:good
